high_level_description: The image depicts a woman stepping out of an airplane. She is wearing a long red dress with white floral accents around the hem and waist. The dress has a loose, flowing design, and she is also wearing black high-heeled shoes. Her hair is styled in a neat, pulled-back manner. The airplane door is open, and the interior of the plane is visible, showing a few items such as a black suitcase labeled "CHANEL" and some other personal belongings on a shelf. The woman appears to be in the process of disembarking, holding onto the door frame for support.
